sources.content: The zephlock-flags image runs the Zephlock feature flag server. It is built on alpine:3.20 and runs as a non-root user named zeph with user ID 10101. The server answers flag evaluation requests on port 8040 and serves its admin dashboard on port 8041. Mount a volume at /var/lib/zephlock to keep flag definitions and audit logs across restarts. The entrypoint is /usr/bin/zephlock, started with the serve subcommand. Images are published for amd64 and arm64.

Environment variables. ZEPH_STORE selects the storage backend and defaults to sqlite; set it to postgres and provide ZEPH_DATABASE_URL to use Postgres. ZEPH_CACHE_TTL sets how long evaluated flags stay cached and defaults to 30 seconds. ZEPH_LOG_LEVEL controls log detail and defaults to info. ZEPH_ADMIN_TOKEN is required, and the container exits at startup if it is missing. The health check requests /readyz every 10 seconds and marks the container unhealthy after 3 failures.
